policy: Preserve business ownership and public behavior while replacing platform mechanisms. These mappings identify implemented native coverage and explicit remaining gaps; they are not a file-count completion percentage. No source file is declared fully equivalent.

groups.name: Frontend session ownership
groups.remaining: Send/stop/resume, immutable references, fork/steer, typed controls and explicit failed-draft recovery are implemented. Durable feed acknowledgement/replay ledgers and the complete shared controller contract remain unported.

groups.name: Native platform client
groups.remaining: In-process native composition now routes Codex, Claude, ACP providers, Pi and the Rust PuppyOne runtime. Complete Electron setup/account/installation services are not represented by this port.

groups.name: Chat presentation
groups.remaining: Native virtual transcript, CommonMark, tables/code/copy, attachment/image previews, commands, typed approval/question/MCP forms, history filtering and controls exist. Mermaid graphics, all provider activity renderers, inline file navigation, accessibility and pixel parity remain pending.

groups.name: Agent workbench items
groups.remaining: Project-retained entities and persisted validated tabs/splits/native identities exist; restart uses explicit resume and never replays terminal commands. Formal RootId/session-registry integration, exact preparation leases and visual drag/drop parity remain pending.

groups.name: Codex runtime and protocol
groups.remaining: Native send/stream/resume/tools/stop plus text/image inputs, fork/steer/rename/compact/archive, modes/effort and typed MCP/permission interactions exist. Full account login UI, all experimental protocol methods and complete event-schema parity are not claimed.

groups.name: Bounded native JSONL transport
groups.remaining: Input/output/frame and aggregate queue limits, bounded redacted stderr, correlated receipts, timed controls and process-group cleanup exist. External crash supervisor and full durable request/replay ledger remain pending.

groups.name: Native installation inventory
groups.remaining: Installed native Chat runtimes are discovered; startup negotiates provider capabilities. Formal cached readiness/version compatibility, installation/setup and global accounts remain pending. OpenCode user-profile plugin failure is recorded separately from isolated handshake verification.

groups.name: Runtime contract and read model
groups.remaining: Provider-independent commands, bounded snapshots, references and typed interactions exist. Full normalized shared schema, stable cross-product identities and durable delivery ledger remain pending.

groups.name: ACP protocol core
groups.remaining: ACP v1 negotiation, prompt/reference input, stream/tool/plan projection, exact permissions, modes/models and native history/load/fork are implemented. Provider-specific extensions, history coverage diagnostics and Hermes/WorkBuddy live inference remain unverified.

groups.name: Pi RPC protocol core
groups.remaining: Pi JSONL commands/events, exact native identity/history hydration, agent_settled/retry outcome handling, tools, extension interactions, effort/model selection, steering/abort/compact/rename are implemented. Live replies and second-turn context pass, but the installed pi-with-claude/opus provider loses model context after process restart; reproduced with the native CLI alone. Broad history discovery and full upstream event/schema parity remain pending.

groups.name: Claude native adapter
groups.remaining: Direct native CLI control protocol replaces SDK bridge. Stream/tools, exact approvals/questions/MCP forms, modes/models, native history, rename/fork/stop are implemented. Full SDK control surface and live inference/resume are not yet verified; configured upstream returned HTTP 522.

groups.name: Product-owned PuppyOne runtime
groups.remaining: A native Rust HTTP/tool harness replaces the Pi SDK worker. OpenAI-compatible model connections, Keychain references, binding generations, approvals, scoped tools, stop and durable sessions are implemented and loopback-tested. Existing Electron encrypted credentials are not imported; managed compute, native provider discovery/catalog verification, full Pi kernel parity and real configured-model inference remain pending.

groups.name: Reference ingestion
groups.remaining: Explicit picker/drop snapshots with MIME/UTF-8/size checks and provider-capability gates exist. Path references are atomic @path mentions inserted at the caret as the composer's inline tokens (spacing as AgentPromptEditor), deleting one drops its reference, and drafts restore them; images stay on the attachment shelf. Product attachment grants, durable binary assets, deduplication, mention navigation and all lifetime policies remain pending.

groups.name: Session catalog and capacity
groups.remaining: Native identities and metadata are stored separately from provider transcripts; a lease limits sessions to eight per workspace and 32 per application. Complete catalog migrations, cross-product durable identity and external crash supervision remain pending.

groups.name: Native rich transcript and composer
groups.remaining: Bounded virtual rows, native Markdown/table/code rendering, copy, previews, slash suggestions and per-thread drafts are implemented. Full renderer registry, Mermaid, inline assets, advanced autocomplete, accessibility and OS visual verification remain pending.
